name: Anarchy Associated

tenures.source: Whiplash of 14 February 2008, whose ring announcer bills 'Jackson and Georgie Nickles ... ANARCHY ASSOCIATED', and the Whiplash of 28 February 2008

caption: Jackson and Georgie Nickles, billed together as Anarchy Associated on the Whiplash of 14 and 28 February 2008; the second of those shows has them lose to C.O.D.

name: C.O.D.

tenures.source: Whiplash of 21 February 2008, where the Demon and Kirsta Lewis announce a group (he calls it a Cadre of Domination) and offer a place to Eric Sailes, and of 28 February and 6 March 2008, where the commentators call the pair C.O.D.

caption: The first alliance in the CWC: Kirsta Lewis and the Demon, announced on 21 February 2008 as a Cadre of Domination, who win a tag match over Anarchy Associated on 28 February 2008 with help from a guest.

identity.note: The same name stands on other wings' records; nothing on this wing's pages ties this group to any of them.

name: The Border Patrol

tenures.source: Whiplash of 7 February 2008, where the chairman looks for 'The Border Patrol' and the two masked wrestlers are brought in by the police

caption: Two masked wrestlers, The Flying Burrito and La Ultima Cebolla, introduced as The Border Patrol on the Whiplash of 7 February 2008.

name: NH Sports Management

tenures.source: Whiplash of 7 February 2008, where Shane Hahn introduces the head of NH Sports Management Incorporated, Noah Hanson, who leaves one of his companions with Hahn

caption: A management firm introduced on the Whiplash of 7 February 2008: Noah Hanson, its head, and Shane Hahn, whom it has signed, with three women who arrive with Hanson.
